coverage_issues: Report 1 (qwen) had a tool error (HTTP 400) when auditing .gitignore, causing it to be marked inconclusive
learnings: Tool errors on non-critical files (like .gitignore) should not force an overall 'inconclusive' verdict. The audit tool should distinguish between security-critical files (PKGBUILD, .install, patches) and non-critical files when determining the final verdict.
Implement retry logic or fallback analysis for failed API requests to prevent tool errors from blocking audit completion.
Consider implementing a 'partial verdict' system where tool errors on non-critical files are noted but don't override the verdict from successfully audited critical files.
